crossRefs.note: He said to me, “Son of man, do you see what they do? Even the great abominations that the house of Israel commit here…
Then he said to me, “Son of man, have you seen what the elders of the house of Israel do in the dark, every man in his…
But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.
He said to me, “Go in, and see the wicked abominations that they do here.”
He said also to me, “You will again see more of the great abominations which they do.”

translations.web: Then he said to me, “Have you seen this, son of man? You will again see yet greater abominations than these.”
translations.bsb: “Son of man,” He said to me, “do you see this? Yet you will see even greater abominations than these.”
translations.kjv: Then said he unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? turn thee yet again, and thou shalt see greater abominations
translations.asv: Then said he unto me, Hast thou seen this, O son of man? thou shalt again see yet greater abominations than these.
